evals.prompt: Table 3 of my paper compares four systems on three benchmarks (accuracy, higher is better); the numbers are in results.csv. Make the results figure for the paper: one panel per benchmark, our system is 'Ours'. Give me the .tex, the PDF and a PNG I can look at.
evals.expected_output: A bar-panel figure generated from the CSV: three panels, rows sorted best first, Ours in blue, values printed at the bar ends, built with a width verdict of ok, PNG delivered, reply states which checks ran.
expectations: Every number in the figure source matches results.csv to the decimal
Rows in every panel are sorted from the highest value to the lowest
The bar of Ours is the only blue bar in each panel; the others are grey
The source loads cardfig.sty and uses the barpanel environment, or was generated by bars_from_csv.py
The figure compiles without error and its page width is at most 397.5 pt
A PNG render is delivered and the reply says which checks were run

evals.prompt: These three figures (plain-bars.tex, plain-lines.tex, plain-scatter.tex) come from three co-authors and look nothing alike. Restyle them so they belong to the same paper. Do not change any data.
evals.expected_output: Three figures in the house style: plotfig.sty with the paper axis style, same fonts and palette, direct labels or a legend row instead of legend boxes, bars from zero, Ours in blue, every coordinate as in the input.
expectations: All three outputs load plotfig.sty and use the paper axis style
Every coordinate list of every addplot is identical to the input file
The series named Ours is drawn in the house blue in all three figures
No figure keeps the default legend box; series are named at line ends, above the bars, or by a legend row
The human reference line in the line chart uses the dashed ref style and is labelled on the plot
The three figures compile and their PNG renders are delivered

evals.prompt: In legend-figure.tex, put the legend inside the plot area at the upper left instead of above the plot. Change nothing else.
evals.expected_output: The same figure with the legend moved; the reply lists the one change and what stayed, shows the diff, and delivers the render or a before/after sheet.
expectations: The legend is placed inside the axis at the upper left
Every addplot line and every coordinate is unchanged
Width, height, bar width, colours, tick labels and the bars labelled style are unchanged
The diff between input and output touches only the legend placement and, at most, a comment
The reply names the change and the list of things kept, and delivers the render or a before/after image
